_comment: Plugin manifest (authored by the plugin author). 'version' is the plugin semver (release-only); install-plugin reads 'setup'.
name: reporting
description: Findings-report authoring + rendering: one self-contained HTML source per report (reports/html/, gitignored working files) styled by a tokenized shared stylesheet, rendered to tracked PDFs with zero npm dependencies (installed Google Chrome driven over the DevTools protocol; page-1 and pages-2+ header passes merged with poppler pdfunite). Theme (body font, accent color) and page furniture (prepared-by byline, watermark, furniture font) are project-owned config outside the plugin copy: reports/theme.css token overrides and reports/report.json. Defaults: Helvetica Neue + Solaris purple; NVIDIA projects override to NVIDIA Sans + NVIDIA green.

notes: External requirements (macOS): installed Google Chrome (or $CHROME pointing at a Chrome binary), Node >= 22 (built-in WebSocket), pdfunite via `brew install poppler`.

Create the working layout on attach: reports/ (tracked PDFs land here), reports/html/ (HTML sources - add `reports/html/` to .gitignore), and the two project-owned config files: reports/theme.css (CSS token overrides on .viz-root; empty file = plugin defaults: Helvetica Neue body font, Solaris purple #6A1B9A accent) and reports/report.json ({"prepared_by": "...", "watermark": "...", "furniture_font": "..."} - all optional).

For NVIDIA projects set the NVIDIA look in reports/theme.css: --font-sans: "NVIDIA Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; --accent: #76b900; and "furniture_font": "NVIDIA Sans" in reports/report.json (NVIDIA Sans installed in ~/Library/Fonts, Helvetica fallback).
Scratch (Chrome profile + intermediate PDFs) lives in $HOME/.solaris/tmp - never inside the project.
